errors.evidence: The chart shows 6 grouped category positions on the x-axis, each with 7 bars (1 blue baseline and 6 orange specialty-finetuned bars), not nine bars total.

errors.text_span: The blue bar represents “Mistralv0.2-Base,” while the orange bars represent models fine-tuned on Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, respectively.
errors.evidence: The legend indicates one blue series for Mistralv0.2-Base and six differently shaded orange series for the fine-tuned specialties; the text incorrectly treats all orange bars as a single series and implies each orange color maps to one specialty only.

errors.text_span: The “Cardio” bar has a value of approximately -23.4, the “Gastro” bar has a value of approximately -23.6, and the “Pediatrics” bar has a value of approximately -23.2. All other bars represent values between -25.8 and -23.8.
errors.evidence: Several of these approximations are not accurate: for example, the Cardio baseline bar is near -26.7, not -23.4, and the Gastro baseline bar is near -24.9, not -23.6. The Pediatrics baseline bar is near -24.7, not -23.2.
The description omits the grouped-bar structure: each x-axis specialty group contains a baseline blue bar plus multiple orange bars corresponding to fine-tuning on the specialties.
The description does not mention that the orange bars use multiple distinct shades to represent the different fine-tuning specialties shown in the legend.
